A.title: HEARTH
A.what: the toll cottage: the road houses' HEARTH (T-538 A) carried out to their front -- thatch in row 5's straw, limewash, terracotta quarry-tile piers, leaded lights in oak, flagstone steps

B.title: THE WAYMARK
B.what: the numbered road's office (3.2): slate roof, dressed ashlar, quoins, sash windows over a blank blue enamel band, milestones, slate treads -- every material kept on its own ramp

C.title: THE LATCH
C.what: the gate as a latch on the bus: a finned heat-sink roof on gold legs, a gold edge-connector, teal board piers with a copper trace, status lamps, a shutter door, header pins
